spans.s: o-kṣapayati (for ava-kṣ˚, caus. to Skt. apa-kṣi), causes to be done away with, orders put away, with ‘inner accusative’ vadham, to death, i.e. orders executed: Mv 〔i.96.7〕 (prose), read with 5 of 6 mss. (aparādhaṃ ca ananuyujyā, read ˚jya, q.v.) vadham okṣapayanti (one ms. ākṣap˚; Senart em. ākṣep˚).
